sites.crates/er-crash-logging-core/src/hang.rs: Hang watchdog thread enumeration. Snapshot only, no suspension; exempted with sample_thread because it is that report path's first step.

Hang watchdog thread snapshot. Cannot be opt-in: a watchdog you enable in advance is off on the run that needed it. Fires only after a detector has already tripped, one thread at a time, no allocation while suspended, capped at 3 stall and 5 frame-drop reports.
